newsitem.title: CHINA: TOP GLORY MULLS BUYING ASSETS FROM PARENT.
newsitem.headline: TOP GLORY MULLS BUYING ASSETS FROM PARENT.

text.p: Top Glory International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it was considering buying assets from its parent company.
"The company is only exploring the possibility of acquiring the assets and no definite decision has been made to proceed with such acquisition or on the timing and terms," it said.
The company said it would make a further statement if it was to proceed with the acquisition. It gave no further details.
Shares of Top Glory fell HK$0.05 to HK$3.40 in mid-morning.
Top Glory, controlled by China-backed China National Cereals Oil and Foodstuffs Import and Export Corp (Ceroil), engages in property investment and food related business.
